title: Feb 10 Bishkek rally for Ruslan Tagaev to become mayor

date_and_location.summary: RFE/RL’s caption and report place demonstrators outside Bishkek city administration on February 10 (lines 127–130).

participants_original.summary: RFE/RL reports that some 30 demonstrators gathered (line 135), an approximate source-attributed crowd below the 50-person threshold.

demand.summary: The demonstrators held posters reading “Ruslan Tagaev for mayor”; the article identifies Tagaev as a former deputy head of the State Agency for Architecture and Construction (lines 135, 140).

notes: This is an exclusion from qualifying event coding based on one opened contemporaneous report and its approximate count; no independent count corroboration was consulted. The article does not establish the physical end or report event-specific state-response or protester-violence outcomes. The appointment changes reported at lines 132–133 are not described as a response to the demonstrators. Unknowns remain unknown; silence is not treated as no response.
